bullets: Dialogue-heavy formats trade grounding for texture — a pattern observed holding across three different teams rather than a one-off impression.
Sometimes the point of a conversation is not having a point; aimlessness can be a deliberate feature of long form rather than a failure mode.
The same dynamics show up at teams using Patreon and teams using Substack — the trade-off follows the format rather than the platform.
Cultural drift cross-cuts every other trade-off in long-form dialogue, making it the point where the conversation gets most interesting.
Running one idea for two weeks beats trying everything at once — the rest is iteration.
